params.command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$root=Join-Path $env:TEMP 'mhw-secret-security-review'
if(Test-Path $root){Remove-Item -Recurse -Force $root}
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/fengie/mhw-mods.git $root
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){exit $LASTEXITCODE}
$oc='C:\Users\Xxkan\local-ai-tools\opencode\package\bin\opencode.exe'
$cfg='C:\Users\Xxkan\HeavenBridge\opencode-fallback.json'
$env:OPENCODE_CONFIG=$cfg
$prompt=@'
You are the independent security architect for Heaven Local Bridge. READ ONLY: do not edit or commit files.
Inspect the current main branch, especially heaven-bridge/worker.py, uia.ps1, plugin skills, plugins/README.md, and plugins/heaven-control-plane.
Goal: credential-safe GUI input where a password/API key originates on heaven2 (credential authority) and is typed on heaven, while the plaintext secret NEVER enters GitHub queue/status/results, logs, controller checkpoints, shell command-line args, environment variables, screenshots, or plugin output.

Evaluate this candidate design adversarially:
- GitHub job carries only an opaque short-lived lease handle plus semantic UI target.
- heaven worker has a new secret_input action; there is NO secret_fetch action.
- secret_input invokes ssh.exe directly with argv (not shell interpolation) to heaven2 over an already-authenticated encrypted SSH/Tailscale path, StrictHostKeyChecking=yes, BatchMode=yes, bounded timeout.
- heaven2 companion authority creates one-time short-TTL leases, storing the secret DPAPI-protected under the current user; lease creation reads secret from stdin/secure prompt, never argv.
- consume receives only a validated base64url handle, decrypts once, deletes lease before/at consumption, writes an encoded secret only to SSH stdout.
- heaven captures stdout only in memory, decodes it, focuses a UIA target, injects with SendInput/Unicode typing directly, then clears references best-effort and returns only metadata/counts.
- auth/config (authority host, known_hosts, remote script path) lives in local machine config/env and never in Git.
- health advertises secret_input only when configured.

Identify concrete weaknesses, replay/race/error leak paths, Windows/SSH/DPAPI issues, and exact tests required. Recommend the smallest production-safe v1, including protocol/result/error contracts. Return a concise structured review with MUST FIX / SHOULD FIX / ACCEPTABLE and no secrets.
'@
& $oc run --standalone --auto --model 'ollama/qwen3:4b' --format json $prompt 2>&1
exit $LASTEXITCODE
